content.text:
**Yes, but not by Michael Torres alone.** The request needs approval from the Director of Finance, Elena Novak, and concurrence from David Morgan, the Chief Revenue Officer. Morgan concurs instead of the VP Sales because the VP Sales is Torres himself, the requestor.

**The request**
- CR-9208 is in Northstar ERP and matches the submission.
- Customer C-1001 asks to go from $250,000 to $650,000, dated 2026-09-23, requested by Michael Torres.
- The justification (third-plant ramp-up) doesn't cite the parent guarantee, so the request relies on the customer's own standing.

**The customer**
- ERP C-1001, "Acme Mfg. Holdings", is the same company as CRM-2048, "Acme Manufacturing".
- Both records share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee.
- The CRM tier is **Strategic**.

**The policy:** CREDIT-POLICY-2026 is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**Payment history** (rule: nothing paid or unpaid more than 30 days after its due date, for invoices due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23):
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24, on time.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22, on time.
- INV-62305 is due 2026-10-02, after the request date, so it isn't counted.
- No late invoices: the customer is eligible.

**The maximum limit**
- The Strategic maximum is $750,000, and $650,000 is within it on the customer's own standing.
- GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000, naming Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force through 2027) would raise this to $1,150,000, but it isn't needed.

**Authority**
- Over $500,000 requires the **Director of Finance**, who is Elena Novak.
- A Strategic account over $500,000 also needs **VP Sales concurrence**. The VP Sales is Torres, and he can't concur on his own request. Under the separation-of-duties rule, the concurrence passes to his manager, **David Morgan (CRO)**.
- Torres has no approval authority under the policy.

**Note:** INV-62305 ($720,000) was unpaid and 6 days past due as of today (2026-10-08). That doesn't affect this decision, but it's worth watching.

  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 Strategic tier maximum (CRM-2048); no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid >30 days past due", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance; VP Sales concurrence (Strategic, >$500,000)",

  "evidence": ["structured/credit_requests.csv CR-9208", "structured/erp_credit.csv C-1001", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 (Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305", "structured/employees.csv EMP-200, EMP-300, EMP-402", "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 (OWM register)", "GRT-ACME-2026 (OWM register; not relied on)"],
